appliesTo: any element with a background image
summary: How big each background image is drawn.
details: cover scales the image until it fills the box and crops the rest; contain scales it until it fits entirely, leaving gaps. Explicit sizes are used for patterns that repeat.

values.note: Fill the box, crop the overflow.
Fit inside the box, maybe with gaps.
Default: the image’s natural size; gradients fill the box.
